facts: Public Session.forward(inputs) receives input tensor vector; no public reset/clear-cache method in inspected header.
SessionNode has private tensor map and forward state; their existence does not prove a bug.
Local plaintext Host Input registration returns inputs. This is not proof of the exact ARM compiled implementation.
Tensor has persistent ready state and waitForReady can return immediately when ready; no proof that readiness was stale in this run.
ZG metadata contains input/value storage and reuse controls; those controls were not changed.
limitations: Existing input files prove PS preprocessing values, but not per-invocation content of the actual SDK input tensor, Input0 returned tensor or staged intermediate tensors.
Callback counts prove dispatch records, not independently fresh hardware data for every invocation.
SDK profile units remain unconfirmed; timing differences and negative other fields are not synchronization proof.
